description:
Compress an existing image to WebP or AVIF: quality 1-100, width/height (downscale), preset
(photo/picture/drawing/icon/text), lossless. Returns a result link (valid up to 5 min),
original and new size, compression ratio. File up to 20 MB.
Input: exactly one of source_url (public URL, the server downloads it), upload_id (create_upload, then PUT) or data_base64 (up to 512 KB).
Rate-limited per day; call quota_status for remaining calls.
